question: With target-correct future tokens, can q=4 verification on the frozen X7 production Ponytail target stack improve long-output committed decode throughput by at least 15% while preserving target logits and causal state exactly?

prior_evidence.not_transferable_reason: The prior target ran serial core and expert rows with P42, P45 and P46 disabled; its own decomposition attributes the loss to the old target expert/storage path. It also measured only token equality, not exact logits or recurrent state.

oracle_fixture.prompt: Name the capital of Japan. Answer with only the city name.
oracle_fixture.acquisition: Before oracle source changes, run frozen X7 autoregressively and archive its emitted target token IDs, per-step raw logits, traffic plan and final causal state. The archived IDs are then immutable q=4 perfect proposals for all oracle arms.

arms: A1: frozen X7 production autoregressive control
B1: q=4 perfect-token oracle on the same production target stack
B2: immediate q=4 perfect-token oracle repeat
A2: reversed frozen X7 autoregressive control
frozen_controls: one target binary for all measured arms
same model, prompt, archived target tokens, provider policy, cache sizes and device topology
performance platform profile and performance CPU policy
no draft model and no draft training
per-layer convolution, SSM and MLA state hashes
primary_metrics: core, expert, join and output wall
physical and logical traffic per committed token
direct I/O, H2D and D2D bytes
convolution, SSM and MLA state hashes
abort_conditions: wrong target stack, device identity or power policy
OOM, swap activity or provider fallback
oracle token, traffic-plan, raw-logit or recurrent-state mismatch
fewer than 32 archived target tokens for the long-output ceiling
oracle execution silently replays accepted rows serially

interpretation.GO: Both exact q=4 oracle arms improve useful long-output decode throughput by at least 15%; integrate and compare the current R9700 DSpark under the same production target closure.
interpretation.NO_GO: Valid exact q=4 oracle arms complete below 1.15x; close draft training as uneconomic for this target stack.
interpretation.INVALID: Any fixture, topology, target-stack, traffic or exactness gate fails; repair only the invalidating condition and repeat the frozen arm order.
